facts.text: Cherry Branch sits on the south bank of the tidal Neuse River, giving it a waterfront feel that shapes daily life.
A free ferry connects Cherry Branch to Minnesott Beach across the Neuse River, offering a quick river crossing for residents.
Residents enjoy a private beach along the Neuse River, perfect for kayaking, fishing, and family picnics with stunning river views.
A dedicated kayak launch area within the subdivision lets paddlers start adventures on the Neuse River right from their neighborhood.
Croatan National Forest trailheads border Cherry Branch, inviting locals to hike, birdwatch, and explore coastal woodlands just a short walk away.
Most homes in Cherry Branch were built around 1990, creating a balanced mix of well-established residences in the community.
